evidence: All tank_core tests pass: 0 failures across all 15 test binaries (approx. 196 tests total). clippy clean, fmt clean.

Action model correctly split: PlayerAction::TrimPlantsAndRemove (export, biomass exits system) and PlayerAction::TrimPlantsAndLeaveCuttings (detritus routing, closed-system) defined in actions.rs:13-18.

Engine handling verified: engine.rs:600-619 exports biomass for Remove variant; engine.rs:620-642 routes to fine_detritus for LeaveCuttings variant. Budget labels correctly assigned at engine.rs:791-792.
Event log/UI text distinguishes the two actions: TUI shows 'Trim & remove' with hint '(exported)' vs 'Trim & leave' with hint '(to detritus)' in crates/tank_tui/src/screens/actions.rs.
Budget instrumentation: Remove variant uses snapshot-delta recording (open-system), explicitly documented in engine.rs:616-617 comment. Budget guard recognizes the label as open-system.
Unit test coverage: test_trim_plants_and_remove_exports_n_and_c (budget_tracking.rs:654-703) asserts total N/C decreases by exactly the exported amount within 1e-6 tolerance.
Unit test coverage: test_trim_plants_and_leave_cuttings_preserves_n_and_c (budget_tracking.rs:624-651) asserts total N/C is conserved within 1e-6 tolerance.
Legacy migration test: legacy_schema_v4_saves_migrate_trim_plants_to_trim_and_remove (save_load.rs:416-497) verifies old TrimPlants actions migrate to TrimPlantsAndRemove with correct fractions.
Integration test: test_weekly_trim_and_remove_exports_nutrients_over_500_hours (budget_tracking.rs:1433-1539) confirms cumulative export matches total N decrease over 500 simulated hours.
SUB_ADULT_FEEDING_WEIGHT unified: single definition at biology.rs:149 (value 0.67, pub(crate)), re-exported via types/mod.rs:24, imported by shrimp.rs:7. No duplicate definitions remain.

Stale trim tests fixed: budget_helpers.rs now tests TrimPlantsAndLeaveCuttings with label 'action:trim_plants_and_leave_cuttings'; plant_algae_integration.rs now tests TrimPlantsAndLeaveCuttings for detritus routing.
findings_or_gaps: No gaps found against acceptance criteria.
